name: tcode
summary: EMBOSS 6.6.0 tcode: Identifies protein-coding regions of a nucleotide sequence with the Fickett TESTCODE statistic, as tcode of EMBOSS 6.6.0.
short: EMBOSS tcode: identifies protein-coding regions of a nucleotide sequence with the fickett testcode statistic; equals tcode 6.6.0 on 300 runs.
description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 tcode: the Fickett TESTCODE statistic of the windows of window bases (at least 200) every step bases, from the base compositions and the position asymmetries of the three codon positions with the probability tables of the data file Etcode.dat (or the datafile given); every window is reported with its score and the estimation Non-coding (below 0.74), No opinion or Coding (0.95 and above) as the report out.txt in the report format reportFormat (default table: every report format of EMBOSS, the report qualifiers of reportQualifiers); with plot the values are plotted against the window mid positions (graph: data writes the data file tcode1.dat, bedgraph the track file tcode.bedgraph, none draws nothing; the devices that draw with plplot (ps, png, svg ...) are refused). Equals the installed program on 300 runs (every input format of seqret, ranges, the report and graph options, the messages of the library; standard output, error stream, exit status and written files byte for byte). B09 WP63, F282.

name: checktrans
summary: EMBOSS 6.6.0 checktrans: Reports the STOP codons and the open reading frames of a protein translation, as checktrans of EMBOSS 6.6.0.
short: EMBOSS checktrans: reports the stop codons and the open reading frames of a protein translation; equals checktrans 6.6.0 on 300 runs.
description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 checktrans: for every protein sequence the stretches between its stops (*) that are at least orfml residues long: the report out.txt lists their positions and the number of stops, the sequences name_N are returned in the file seqout.txt (sequence format outputFormat) and the protein feature table in the file features.txt (feature format featureFormat, default gff3); with addlast (default) a stop is forced at the end (it is not counted). Equals the installed program on 300 runs (every input format of seqret, ranges, the report and graph options, the messages of the library; standard output, error stream, exit status and written files byte for byte). name: wordfinder
summary: EMBOSS 6.6.0 wordfinder: Matches large sequences against one or more other sequences by their words, as wordfinder of EMBOSS 6.6.0.
short: EMBOSS wordfinder: matches large sequences against one or more other sequences by their words; equals wordfinder 6.6.0 on 300 runs.
description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 wordfinder: the target sequences (bsequence) are indexed by their words of wordlen residues, every query sequence (asequence) is looked up in the index, the diagonal with the most word residues fixes the start points and a banded Smith-Waterman alignment of width cells (gap penalties gapopen / gapextend, matrix datafile: an EMBOSS matrix name such as EDNAFULL or EBLOSUM62, or the text of a matrix file) is written in the alignment format alignFormat (every -aformat of EMBOSS, default simple, with the sub-header lines Wordscore and Alignlength) as out.txt; the matches and alignments excluded by limitmatch / lowmatch / limitalign / lowalign and the matches per target are written to err.txt. Equals the installed program on 300 runs (every input format of seqret, ranges, the report and graph options, the messages of the library; standard output, error stream, exit status and written files byte for byte). name: marscan
summary: EMBOSS 6.6.0 marscan: Finds matrix/scaffold recognition (MRS) signatures in DNA sequences, as marscan of EMBOSS 6.6.0.
short: EMBOSS marscan: finds matrix/scaffold recognition (mrs) signatures in dna sequences; equals marscan 6.6.0 on 300 runs.
description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 marscan: the MAR/SAR recognition signatures: the 16 bp site awwrtaannwwgnnnc (one mismatch allowed) or its reverse gnnncwwnnttaywwt and the 8 bp site aataayaa or ttrttatt within 200 bp of each other; of a cluster of signatures the pair with the least distance is reported as the report out.txt (default format gff: the feature misc_signal with the positions of the two sites; every report format of EMBOSS, the report qualifiers of reportQualifiers). short: EMBOSS plotorf: plots the potential open reading frames of a nucleotide sequence; equals plotorf 6.6.0 on 300 runs.
